these_are_controls_not_evidence: PC-1 (DV-6) AND DV-7 ARE CONTROLS AND ARE NOT EVIDENCE. Neither bears on H-EQD-001 or on HEUR-DS-1 and neither may be cited as bearing on them. DV-7's non-rejection is EXPRESSLY NOT CORROBORATION OF ANYTHING.

PC-1_DV-6.objects: the certified OBJ-PLANT-delta object built on a fresh real-arm-null-stream OBJ-NULL-RFB draw, versus a further fresh OBJ-NULL-RFB draw from the same stream
PC-1_DV-6.plant_construction: a fraction certified_delta of the n pairs has e_1 replaced by a uniform draw from [0, floor(p/2)); e_2 is left unchanged

DV-7_apparatus_identity.objects: two fresh independent OBJ-NULL-RFB draws at the same cell
DV-7_apparatus_identity.comparison: value > threshold, strict; ok_not_rejecting is its negation
DV-7_apparatus_identity.not_corroboration: Derivably the same law. Agreement here is NOT corroboration of anything; only a rejection would be informative, as an implementation defect.
